biography.value:
殘暴的灰矮人，也被稱爲杜爾加人。它們在幽暗地域深處的奇妙城市裏居住，靠着遠古矮人的知識以及無數的奴隸不知疲倦的擴大着它們的地底王國。
大多灰矮人（甚至女灰矮人）都有着一些統一的外貌特徵：禿頭，和灰白色的皮膚。它們身穿的土褐色服裝和設計簡單的首飾，既反映着其嚴謹和實用主義風範，又可以讓它們跟周圍的岩石環境融爲一體，不易被察覺。

從奴隸到奴隸販子Slaves to Slavers。灰矮人曾經只是普通的矮人。它們對土層以下貪婪而無休止的深入挖掘最終導致其跟奪心魔mind flayer進行接觸。被靈吸怪們illithid奴役好幾代後，灰矮人們最終在邪神拉杜格Laduguer的幫助下重獲得自由。長年的奴役永遠的改變了它們，使它們被黑化的精神變得跟曾經的暴君主子一樣邪惡。贏得自由的灰矮人依然是陰沉、悲觀且多疑的生物。它們總是邊抱怨邊埋頭苦幹，也不會可以去在意什麼自豪和快樂。雖然它們精妙的工藝和技術一直在流傳，卻不再具有熱情和藝術感。
灰矮人們對其矮人近親和其他地下種族發動戰爭。它們隨意結盟，又在利用完對方後迅速分道揚鑣。它們在幽暗地域抓捕其他人做奴隸，然後把它們當作免費勞力和原始硬通幣使用。

頑石般結實Tough as Stone。灰矮人跟它的矮人近親一樣強壯結實。除了強壯的體魄外，灰矮人還因靈吸怪的奴役鍛煉出了無比堅強的心智。灰矮人的意志是一座堅實的堡壘，它們能夠靠自己擺脫魅惑、幻覺甚至其他魔法。

生於黑暗Born of Darkness。幽暗地域充滿強大的魔力。從被奴役關押的年代開始，灰矮人就不斷吸收着這些怪異魔力，最終令它們得到了某些奇特的能力。它們可以短時間增大體型，成爲一個相當於獸人身型尺寸的強大戰士。當面臨強敵或者監視入侵領地的生物時，它們還可以隱身入黑暗中行動。

灰矮人的黑暗視覺隨着世代的幽暗地域生活而變得更加精銳，其在相同情況下，能見距離是它們矮人近親的兩倍。而這種敏銳的視力也使它們的眼睛非常容易被陽光刺傷。

來自地獄的主人Infernal Master。九層地獄的主人阿斯蒙蒂斯Asmodeus冒充灰矮人的神，並給其整個種族的內心根植培養了邪惡的意志。這事雖然已經不再是祕密，但邪神依然隱瞞着其正真的身份，暗地裏用神力指引灰矮人不斷殘暴的向它們的敵人展開復仇。

The tyrannical duergar, also known as gray dwarves, dwell in fantastic cities deep in the Underdark. Using ancient dwarven knowledge and myriad slaves, they work tirelessly to expand their subterranean kingdoms.

Most duergar (including females) are bald and have ashen gray skin. They wear drab clothing designed to blend in with stone, along with simple jewelry that reflects their severe and utilitarian demeanor.

Slaves to Slavers. The duergar were once dwarves, before their greed and endless delving beneath the earth brought them into contact with the mind flayers. Held in captivity for generations by the illithids, the dwarves eventually won their independence with the aid of the evil god Laduguer. Slavery had forever changed them, however, darkening their spirits to make the duergar as evil as the tyrants they had escaped. Despite winning their freedom, duergar are dour, pessimistic, untrusting creatures, always toiling and complaining, with no memory of what it means to be happy or proud. Their craftsmanship and accomplishments endure, yet they are bereft of warmth or artistry.

Duergar make war against their dwarven kin and all other subterranean races. They forge alliances when it is convenient, then break those alliances when they have nothing more to gain. They take and hold slaves to toil in the Underdark, regarding them as free labor and crude currency.

Tough as Stone. Like dwarves, duergar have strong constitutions. Adding to their physical stamina is an incredible mental fortitude resulting from their time as slaves of the illithids. A duergar's mind is a fortress, able to shrug off charms, illusions, and other spells.

Born of Darkness. The Underdark is saturated with strange magical power, which the duergar absorbed over generations of imprisonment. A duergar can increase its size and strength for a short time, becoming a powerful ogre-sized warrior. If it faces a foe it can't fight, or when spying on creatures approaching its territory, it can just as easily become &Reference[condition=invisible] to slip away into the darkness. Eons spent in the Underdark also sharpened their &Reference[rule=darkvision], allowing them to see twice as far as other dwarves. This keen eyesight comes at a cost, however, as a duergar's vision is compromised by sunlight.

Infernal Master. Asmodeus, Lord of the Nine Hells, has been known to impersonate duergar gods in order to cultivate the evil brimming in the hearts of the gray dwarves. He offers them divine guidance and vengeance against their enemies while urging them on toward greater acts of tyranny, all the while concealing his true identity.

description.value:
灰矮人用魔法將自己連同其裝備或攜帶的所有東西一起變得巨大，並持續1分鐘。變巨效應持續時，灰矮人體型變爲大型，以力量爲基礎的武器攻擊其傷害骰翻倍（已包含在攻擊項中），且其進行的力量檢定和力量豁免具有優勢。當灰矮人所處的空間不足夠容納大型體型生物時，變巨的尺寸會按照空間可容納的最大值來確定。

For 1 minute, the duergar magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the duergar is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

近戰武器攻擊：命中+4，觸及5尺，單一目標。命中：6（1d8+2）點穿刺傷害，在變巨時爲11（2d8+2）點穿刺傷害。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+4]]{+4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 ([[/damage 1d8 + 2 type=piercing]]) damage, or 11 ([[/damage 2d8 + 2 type=piercing]]) damage while enlarged.

近戰或遠程武器攻擊：命中+4，觸及5尺，或射程30/120尺，單一目標。命中：5（1d6+2）點穿刺傷害，在變巨時爲9（2d6+2）點穿刺傷害。

Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+4]]{+4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 ([[/damage 1d6 + 2 type=piercing]]) damage, or 9 ([[/damage 2d6 + 2 type=piercing]]) damage while enlarged.

灰矮人用魔法隱去身形，效果持續到它發動攻擊，施展法術，使用變巨特質或者其專注被打斷（如同專注一個法術）。如果持續專注於該法術，效果將至多持續1小時。灰矮人身上着裝和攜帶的所有裝備將隨它一同隱形。

The duergar magically turns &Reference[condition=invisible] until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its @status[concentration] is broken, up to 1 hour (as if @status[concentration||concentrating] on a spell). Any equipment the duergar wears or carries is &Reference[condition=invisible] with it.

灰矮人抵抗中毒，法術和幻覺時，進行的豁免檢定具有優勢。抵抗魅惑和麻痹狀態時，也是一樣。

The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being &Reference[condition=charmed] or &Reference[condition=paralyzed].

在陽光照射下，灰矮人進行的攻擊檢定具有劣勢，此時其依賴視覺進行的感知（察覺）檢定也具有劣勢。

While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (&Reference[skill=Perception]) checks that rely on sight.
This armor consists of a coat and leggings (and perhaps a separate skirt) of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal, much like the scales of a fish. The suit includes gauntlets.
A shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
